title: Embossed bowl signature
slide_intent: Let material relief carry identification so a simple object can feel branded without added ink.
strategic_value: A subtle raised wordmark can connect Sweetgreen’s serving vessel to the identity through touch and light.
demonstration: The sweetgreen wordmark is embossed across the inside of a pale molded bowl, with the rim casting a broad curved shadow.
practical_value: Evaluate whether relief and lighting make a low-contrast signature readable on packaging.

content_islands.name: Embossed wordmark
content_islands.spec: Center the raised lettering within the bowl surface.

content_islands.name: Vessel relief
content_islands.spec: Retain the rim, texture and shadow that reveal the material form.

reference_purposes.Application: The wordmark is formed in the bowl material rather than printed as a contrasting graphic.
reference_purposes.Expression: Tonal relief and shadow create a restrained signature.
